preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(h, int) and 0 <= h <= 10**5 for h in [h12, h13, h14, h23, h24, h34])
preconditions.description: All Hamming distances must be non-negative integers not exceeding 100000.

preconditions.expression: any(h > 0 for h in [h12, h13, h14, h23, h24, h34])
preconditions.description: At least one Hamming distance must be positive.
Exactly six Hamming distances must be provided.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not feasible else True
postconditions.description: Output -1 if no suitable set of strings exists.
All output strings must have the same length.

postconditions.expression: all(h(s1, s2) == h12 and h(s1, s3) == h13 and h(s1, s4) == h14 and h(s2, s3) == h23 and h(s2, s4) == h24 and h(s3, s4) == h34)
postconditions.description: The Hamming distances between the output strings must match the input distances.
